title: 第五章 开学典礼
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

没有网络，不可能随时随地视频通话，想念谁了，拿照片出来看看，是唯一的慰藉。就算拍照片价格高昂，仍旧会有不少人来拍，尤其是新婚夫妻还有毕业学生。

包国维穿着军装走进了照相馆。

人靠衣装，包国维的精神气质不错。

老板自然也不敢怠慢。

连忙问了下包国维的需求。

为了省点钱随便拍一张。

拍照的费用直接把包国维吓了一跳，最贵的大一点的，要几十块大洋一张，懵逼了，一张照片就能抵一套房。

最便宜最普通的也要一块大洋，工人好几天的工资直接没了。平头老百姓哪里消费的起，一生估计也就结婚的时候赶赶时髦拍上一张，也可能终生都不会拍照。

包国维发自内心的说道：“这么贵。”

老板连忙说：“可不敢哄您，的确是这个价。”

“行吧，拍一张最便宜的。”

拍的速度很快，但洗照片就较慢了：“还麻烦长官您等上三天，三天后再来我这儿取照片。”

包国维出了门去，感慨着这照相馆老板一定能发财，利润绝对少不了。

又去别的店铺买了点东西。

像锅碗瓢盆啥的，军校里面都有提供，但也需要买点其他的物件。

想着去买一支钢笔，倒是从家里带了一支钢笔过来，但不是那么好写了，想买支新的。虽是军校，也有文化课的，笔很重要。一天时间差不多是半天教堂内的军事理论课，还有半天是教堂外的军训课。

买好笔，在广州找了家洋行进去买钢笔。

自己毛笔字写的很差，但钢笔字尚可。

尤其是穿越过来之后，感觉自己的学习能力十分地强，这硬币书法是越来越好了，或许毛笔字也该好好练练。

问了下价格就打消了暂时要买的念头，好家伙，稍微好点的钢笔就要十块大洋，顶他爹老包一个月工钱。

他爹给了他十块大洋，再加上初试通过发放的路费几块大洋。

如果要是买了这的钢笔，那可就分币不剩了。

钢笔缓一缓再买，要想法子搞点钱，现在的钱是真不够用。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Without the Internet, it is impossible to make video calls anytime and anywhere. Showing photos of someone you miss is the only comfort.Even though the price of taking photos is high, many people still come to take photos, especially newlyweds and graduates.

Bao Guowei walked into the photo studio wearing military uniform.

People rely on clothes, and Bao Guowei has a good spirit and temperament.

The boss naturally didn't dare to neglect.

He quickly asked Bao Guowei about his needs.

Just take a photo to save some money.

Bao Guowei was shocked by the cost of taking photos. The most expensive and larger ones cost dozens of yuan each. It was shocking. One photo can be worth a house.

The cheapest and most common ones cost an ocean, and the workers lost several days of wages.Ordinary people with flat heads cannot afford to spend money. In their lifetime, they will probably only snap up a photo when they get married, or they may never take a photo at all.

Bao Guowei said from the bottom of his heart: "It's so expensive."

The boss quickly said: "I dare not coax you, it is indeed this price."

"Okay, take the cheapest one."

The shooting speed is very fast, but the development of the photos is slower: "Sir, please wait three days and come back to me to pick up the photos in three days."

Bao Guowei went out, feeling that the photo studio owner would definitely make a fortune and the profits would be indispensable.

I went to another store to buy some things.

Pots and pans are provided in the military academy, but you also need to buy some other items.

I was thinking about buying a pen, but I brought a pen from home, but it wasn’t that easy to write with, so I wanted to buy a new one.Although it is a military school, there are also cultural classes, and pens are very important.The day consisted of almost half a day of military theory classes inside the church, and the other half of a day of military training classes outside the church.

After buying a pen, I found a foreign store in Guangzhou to buy pens.

My calligraphy with calligraphy is very poor, but my calligraphy with fountain pen is acceptable.

Especially after traveling through time, I feel that my learning ability is very strong. My coin calligraphy is getting better and better. Maybe I should also practice my calligraphy with brush.

After asking about the price, I gave up the idea of ​​buying it for the time being. Good guy, a slightly better pen costs ten dollars, which is the same as his father's salary for a month.

His father gave him ten yuan, plus a few yuan for travel expenses if he passed the first test.

If you buy a pen from here, you won't have any cents left.

Please wait a little longer before buying a pen. If you want to find some way to make some money, you really don’t have enough money now.
